sidebar.scope: Native click event to saved sidebar aria-pressed change

input.scope: Native textarea input event to enabled message button

eventDisplay.scope: Persisted execution_text engine timestamp to first corresponding DOM text; same OS clock

stopFeedback.scope: Native Stop click to stopping or interrupted DOM status

stopFinished.scope: Native Stop click to actual interrupted task displayed; HTTP model wait, no local tool

startup.scope: Fresh app/WebView profiles, process creation to automation observing connected engine and enabled input; includes CDP connection overhead and is not a true cold-start claim

visibleEvent.scope: Engine saved text event to complete unoccluded foreground viewport text over two animation frames

resourceCoverage.identityBoundary: PID + actual process start time; executable paths are verified before sampling

scope: Fixed local model, actual native Windows desktop and tools; four serial suites without another project workload. UI DOM feedback, foreground renderer opportunity, process exit and warm OS-cache startup reported separately. Not true cold startup, physical monitor scan-out or four-hour stability.
